name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 3 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 3a. Reiterates that Europe has also suffered the consequences of the war and the continent is in dire need of stability and a ceasefire; calls for a new and comprehensive strategy to pursue a peace settlement that guarantees long-term security for Ukraine and the EU;
